summary_en: The video documents a new school year opening ceremony at a charity class organized by Herbalife and volunteers. The event features teacher Huỳnh Ngọc Định, local representatives, and many disadvantaged students. Key activities include opening speeches, students applauding, and the distribution of gift bags, books, and toys to children both inside the classroom and outdoors.
